notes.title: Borderlands 2 VR Quality of Life Patch: January 29, 2020
notes.notes:
Today, we will release a patch for [url=https://borderlands.com/locale-redirect.html?url=%2Fnews%2F2019-10-22-borderlands-2-vr-pc%2F]Borderlands 2 VR[/url] that adds support for the Valve Index headset as well as some community-requested quality of life improvements!

[b]Official Index Support[/b]
[list][*]BL2VR now supports the Index headset![/*][*]Added Index controller meshes, in-game controller layouts and created a new Index Binding as the default option for Knuckles controllers (named “2K Knuckles Config”)[/*][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35865371/0f5b7339edd7cef97aeeca6043778b078b427bed.png[/img]

[b]Motion controller-based movement[/b]
[list][*]Added an option in-game to change between head vs. MOVER-based movement[/*][/list]
[b]Scope Framerate Option[/b]
[list][*]Added an option to choose between 30, 60, 90, and 120 FPS for the scope window[/*][/list]

notes.title: Update To Address HTC Vive Distortion
notes.notes:
An update has been pushed out for Borderlands 2 VR to address the scaling distortion that some players have reported experiencing on the HTC Vive headset. 

If you continue to experience issues after the update, please submit a ticket to [url=https://support.2k.com]support.2k.com[/url]
